description: Composition policy for radially-symmetric mechanical assemblies — gears, fans, turbines, wheels, valves. Pattern: central spindle (primary_volume) with a radially-arrayed feature ring (gear teeth / fan blades / cooling fins / spoke arms), optional rim/flange, optional bearing/hub feature. Expansions add a teeth_ring node when the brief declares a teeth-count, a rim node when a rim_width is set, and a hub node when bore_radius is set. All node additions are non-family-keyed — the policy applies to any asset whose authored intent contains a primary_volume tagged as 'radial_spindle'.
